prepareInstallation.description: A recipe (see script/Recipes.sol). Contracts that don't exist yet are named with placeholders: DAO_REF, PLUGIN_REF and ref(i) for component i.

components.name: components
components.description: Components to clone, initialized in this order.

components.name: initData
components.description: The component's initialize call, with placeholders.

components.name: budget
components.description: The flow's budget: ref(i) of a budget component.

components.name: nodes
components.description: The tree. Node 0 is the root.

components.name: action
components.description: ref(i) of an action component, or address(0) for a branch without an action.

components.name: children
components.description: Indexes of the child nodes, each greater than this node's.

components.name: weights
components.description: One per child when there are 2+, summing to 1,000,000.

components.name: grants
components.description: Permissions to grant, beyond EXECUTE and CONFIGURE which the setup always grants. Each may only target the plugin (PLUGIN_REF) or one of the recipe's components (ref(i)).

components.name: who
components.description: Any address, DAO_REF, PLUGIN_REF or ref(i).

prepareUninstallation.description: The recipe's grants, exactly as installed. They are checked against a hash stored at installation.

inputs.name: grants
inputs.description: Permissions to grant, beyond EXECUTE and CONFIGURE which the setup always grants. Each may only target the plugin (PLUGIN_REF) or one of the recipe's components (ref(i)).

components.name: who
components.description: Any address, DAO_REF, PLUGIN_REF or ref(i).
